title: From Vibe Coding to Production: How to Get Your First Paying Users
summary: You built the app. Now what? This guide covers the exact steps to go from vibe-coded prototype to real users, first revenue, and a product that scales.
body_markdown: No — Blink includes the database, auth, and hosting in one platform. You don't need a Supabase account, Vercel config, or separate auth service. If you're on Lovable or Bolt, you'll typically need to set up Supabase (for the database and auth) and a separate hosting provider (Vercel or Netlify) — that's the three-tool stack those platforms require.
